partners.diseaseBName: ectodermal dysplasia 11A, hypohidrotic/hair/tooth type, autosomal dominant
partners.mechanism_chain: EDAR (HGNC:3064) —DISRUPTS→ Ectodermal development pathway (GO:0007399); EDARADD (HGNC:25701) —DISRUPTS→ Ectodermal development pathway (GO:0007399); Ectodermal development pathway (GO:0007399) —LEADS_TO→ Hypohidrotic ectodermal dysplasia (HP:0000989); Ectodermal development pathway (GO:0007399) —LEADS_TO→ Hair anomaly (HP:0001083); Ectodermal development pathway (GO:0007399) —LEADS_TO→ Anodontia (HP:0000125). Mutations in either EDAR or EDARADD disrupt the downstream ectodermal development pathway, leading to the shared phenotypes of hypohidrotic ectodermal dysplasia, hair anomalies, and tooth anomalies. falsification.text: Identification of a specific pathogenic variant in EDAR or EDARADD in patients with Disease A that is known to cause a gain-of-function or dominant-negative effect, rather than loss-of-function, would falsify the proposed mechanism.
